observations: I opened assets/panels/03-1.png, checkin-patients.png, main-cast.png and workflow/review/page-03.png with Read and looked at them myself.

Mr. Raman matches his sheet. He has short white hair, bushy white eyebrows, round wire reading glasses, deep-set smiling eyes with smile lines, a long oval face, prominent ears and a cream half-sleeve shirt with a pocket. Grey trousers show at the bottom edge. His smile is warm and unhurried.

Raman's hands match production. He stands three-quarter toward screen-right. His near hand, the right, holds the crook of the wooden walking stick at the lower left. His far hand, the left, rests flat on the counter. Fingers and knuckles are clean.

Meera matches her sheet. She has large round eyes with a visible lower lash line, thin high arched brows and a round face. Her long black side braid falls over her left shoulder (screen-right) and has a teal tie. She wears the blue block-print kurta, and the silver bangle is on her right wrist (screen-left). She smiles at Raman with an open mouth.
Meera's hands match production. Both hands are on the keyboard. The desktop monitor at the right is angled toward her and shows only its back, so no screen is visible.

The setting matches the reception section. The glass entrance is at the left, with a QR stand showing an abstract block pattern and a blank teal strip. The vitals corner holds a BP cuff, an oximeter and a small monitor with abstract blocks only. The wall TV shows a teal screen with one empty white strip. Two waiting patients are seen from behind, one in a grey shirt and one in dark brown. There is no readable text, number or personal data anywhere.
The plain wall at the upper left takes the caption. On page-03.png the caption covers the upper left and part of the TV but no faces or hands.
Minor, not blocking: Meera has a small dark dot on her upper cheek near her eye that is not on her sheet. The cast's left-cheek dimple trait does not show, which is acceptable for this smile.
